description:
Top players by current market value, overall or filtered to one position (QB/RB/WR/TE, or PICK for rookie draft picks).

USE WHEN: the user asks for rankings, tiers, 'who are the top dynasty WRs', or wants to find trade targets in a value range.

format.description: Value set to use. Default 'dynasty'. IMPORTANT: there is exactly ONE dynasty table and its QB values are superflex/market-weighted — dynasty values are not split by 1QB vs superflex or by scoring. The redraft sets ARE split: redraft-{sf,1qb}-{ppr,half,std}.

position.description: Filter to one position. 'PICK' returns rookie draft picks. Omit for overall.

name: tradegauge_get_rankings
title: Get value rankings
